cat > programs/task-3772cf39.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==2]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    mask={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0]); h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    for dr in range(H-h+1):
      for dc in range(W-w+1):
        if all(grid[dr+r][dc+c]==0 for r,c in mask):
          for r,c in mask: out[dr+r][dc+c]=2
    return out
PY
